data.title: Engineering Manager
data.description:
About Us

Parity is one of the world’s most experienced companies building the core infrastructure behind blockchain — the system that allows information and value to be shared securely without needing an intermediary. We’re laying the foundation for a better web which respects the freedom and data of individuals, and empowers developers to build better, more trustworthy online services.


Our remote-first, global team develop open-source software that anyone can use or improve. This includes Polkadot, Polkadot SDK, and Kusama — key parts of the Web3 tech stack, the next generation of the internet.Our mission is to make Polkadot the most active and innovative community in blockchain, powering a new era of connected and decentralised applications.

About the Team

We are looking to hire across our Acceleration Function which includes Runtime, Node, Platform and Applied Engineering.

 

About the Role

We're hiring an Engineering Manager who combines people leadership with strong delivery and project management. This isn't a hands-on coding role, but you'll need enough technical depth to understand architecture, engage credibly with engineers, and support sound decision-making.

You'll focus on team health, execution, planning, and cross-functional coordination, helping the team navigate trade-offs, timelines, and stakeholder expectations. A background as a Technical Project Manager or Engineering Manager in a deeply technical environment would be a strong fit.

What You’ll Do

  • Lead, coach, and support a team of around 9 engineers within one of our functions

  • Create a healthy, high-trust team environment with a strong focus on people management and team care

  • Drive planning, prioritisation, and execution across complex technical workstreams

  • Negotiate timelines and delivery trade-offs with stakeholders in a clear and pragmatic way

  • Build enough technical context to understand architecture discussions and help translate them into executable plans

  • Partner closely with technical leaders and contributors to keep projects moving and unblock delivery

  • Improve team ways of working, communication, and delivery predictability in a distributed environment

  • Support hiring, onboarding, and ongoing development of team members as the organisation grows

What You’ll Bring

  • Experience leading engineering or highly technical teams in an Engineering Manager or Technical Project Manager capacity

  • Strong people management skills, with a track record of building healthy teams and supporting individual growth

  • Excellent project and delivery management skills, including planning, dependency management, and stakeholder communication

  • Sufficient technical depth to understand complex system architecture and work effectively with senior engineers

  • Comfort operating in a role that is more focused on leadership and delivery than on hands-on coding

  • Strong judgement when balancing technical complexity, team wellbeing, and delivery outcomes

  • Experience working with distributed teams, ideally across Europe or closely aligned European time zones

  • Nice to have: experience in similarly technical or infrastructure-heavy environments

About Working With Us

Joining Parity means joining team mates who are genuinely excited about the impact their projects are having, and the opportunity to grow alongside some of the brightest minds in the Web3 space! You’ll work remotely and flexibly, while still getting to meet your team mates throughout the year at team and company-wide retreats.

Upon receiving an offer, all candidates undergo a background check through Zinc, our trusted third-party provider. Team members will be taken on as a contractor via our UK entity. View our Applicant Notice to see how we use your data.

Parity is an Equal Opportunity Employer. We welcome diversity in our global team and care about everyone in our collective feeling included and welcome

Is this position not quite your match? Browse our other open roles.

data.title: Accounts Payable Manager (f/m/d)
data.description:
About Focused Energy

Focused Energy is building the future of clean energy through laser-driven inertial

fusion. Backed by our $240M Series A — the largest fully secured Series A in the global

fusion industry — we are scaling rapidly across multiple geographies.

Based in Germany and the US, we have brought together the top scientific and

engineering minds using proven technologies to unlock fusion power at commercial

scale. Focused Energy is working to realize game-changing scientific innovation that

promises to deliver a clean, sustainable and abundant source of power globally.

Your Role

We are looking for a dedicated Accounts Payable Manager (f/m/d): someone who runs the bill-to-pay process end-to-end with the rigor a multi-entity, multi-currency environment requires. You will take over AP from our external bookkeeper during the transition period and lead the move from manual processing to automated workflows.

What You'll Do

Own the end-to-end accounts payable process across all Focused Energy entities, from Bill receipt through payment and reconciliation.

Lead the resolution of supplier and internal payment discrepancies, including duplicate invoices and incorrect payments.

Drive timely month-end and year-end close support, including reconciliations, accruals, prepaid expenses, amortization, and AP reporting.

Ensure bills are coded, approved, and paid in line with company policy and segregation-of-duties controls.

Build and maintain complete, audit-ready documentation for internal and external audits.

Improve automation and data quality across the invoice-to-pay process using our ERP and AP systems.

Partner with suppliers and internal teams to resolve invoice and account-related issues quickly and professionally.

Enable scalable, auditable AP operations by keeping clear, current procedures across all entities.

What You Bring

  • 2-3 years of experience in accounts payable in a German company, with solid knowledge of AP processes and controls: bill-to-pay, PO and non-PO workflows, supplier master data, and segregation of duties.

  • Hands-on experience with NetSuite (or a comparable ERP) and the month-end close, including reconciliations, cost accruals, and AP reporting.

  • A process-improvement mindset: you document procedures clearly, care about data quality, and are open to automation and AI-enabled tools.

  • Strong knowledge of German accounting principles and internal controls, with the ability to work to audit requirements.

  • Clear, professional communication in English and German, with the ability to explain payment status and policy requirements without ambiguity.

  • Ownership and reliability: you take full accountability for accuracy and timeliness and flag issues before they are asked about.

Nice to Have

  • Experience with Moss or Ramp for AP automation and invoice workflows.

  • Experience in a multi-entity, multi-currency environment.

  • Experience in a scale-up environment.

 

What We Offer

  • Innovative Technology & Mission: Be part of a cutting-edge company working on groundbreaking research in clean energy and scientific discovery.

  • Career Development: We invest in our people. This is an opportunity to join an early, growing company at the forefront of new technology, where you’ll have the opportunity to develop and grow your career.

  • Collaborative Culture: Work with great people in a dynamic, international environment with top-tier scientists, engineers and professionals passionate about solving global challenges.

  • Ownership: Take ownership from day 1 and drive impact by making decisions, solving challenges and shaping the future of our company.

  • Your Success is our Success: We offer a competitive salary and company ownership in the form of stock options, giving you a direct stake in our success and ownership in what we build together.

  • Vacation Days: We support your work-life-balance by granting you 30 days of vacation per year.

  • Snacks and Drinks: Our office fridges are never empty. Enjoy our healthy snacks and drinks. Our Darmstadt office even offers a canteen with delicious lunch options daily.

  • Retirement Plan: If you decide for a private pension plan, we will finance 20% on top of your monthly contributions, plus loyalty incentives.

  • Equipment: We offer state-of-the-art Windows or Apple Laptops. In addition, you will receive a keyboard, mouse and headset so you are fully equipped from day 1.

  • Events: We organize regular events to foster team bonding, encourage collaboration, and build a strong, supportive company culture. Connect with colleagues across departments, share ideas, and have fun together, both in and outside of the workplace.

  • Mobility with NAVIT: We partner with NAVIT to support your flexible commuting needs—whether it’s a public transportation ticket, taxi rides or car-sharing you choose what fits your lifestyle.

  • Fitness with Wellhub: We care about your health. Get access to a wide range of gyms, fitness studios and wellness services across Europe through our partnership with Wellhub.

 


Focused Energy is an equal opportunity employer committed to creating an inclusive environment. Qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender perception or identity, national origin, age, marital status, protected veteran status, or disability status.

Pursuant to the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance, Focused Energy will consider for employment qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records.

Compensation offered will be determined by factors such as location, level, job-related knowledge, skills, and experience. Certain roles may be eligible for incentive compensation, equity, benefits.

Your Role

As our Fixed Asset Manager (f/m/d), you will build the fixed asset function from the ground up, creating the processes, controls, and documentation that keep our asset base accurate, audit-ready, and scalable. There is no single owner of fixed asset judgment across our entities today, so you will set the standards and become the go-to expert for the entire company.

You will work directly with the Director of Operational Finance and partner closely with Accounting, Procurement, and the operations teams at our sites.


What You'll Do

  • Own the annual fixed asset inventory: Plan and run the year-end physical inventory and reconcile the results to the asset register.

  • Structure the asset register: Define clear data standards, and maintain an accurate, reconciled register across all entities.

  • Define the capitalization lifecycle: Set up a clear, documented process from construction in progress (CIP) to asset activation, including capitalization decisions, depreciation tables, impairment, and disposals.

  • Manage public funding bookings: Establish the booking logic for subsidized assets, including treatment of grants and the related depreciation and reporting requirements.

  • Automate the purchase-to-asset process: Work with Procurement to design a documented, automated flow from purchase order to capitalized asset in NetSuite and NetAssets.

  • Build procedures and enable the team: Document policies and work instructions, so the process runs reliably, and hand over clear procedures to the emerging team.

  • Partner across the business: Work with project, construction, and site teams to get timely, reliable information on assets under construction and assets placed into service.

  • Support audit readiness: Prepare reconciliations and supporting documentation, and act as the day-to-day contact for external auditors on fixed asset matters.

What You Bring

  • Solid experience in fixed asset accounting, including capitalization, construction in progress, depreciation methods and lifetime tables, impairment, and disposals

  • Experience with public funding, grants, or subsidy booking

  • Hands-on experience with year-end physical inventories, asset reconciliations, and working with external auditors

  • A process improvement and documentation mindset, with an openness to using automation and AI tools to make finance work more efficient

  • Strong analytical skills and attention to detail, with the ability to build structure in an environment that is still taking shape

  • Clear communication skills in English and German

  • Comfort working cross-functionally with engineering, operations, and procurement colleagues

Nice to Have

  • Working knowledge of NetSuite and/or NetAssets, with an interest in improving systems and processes

  • Experience in a manufacturing, energy, or capital-intensive industry with significant assets under construction
